title: Vehicle Dynamic Test and Equipment
seoDescription: imc measurement systems for vehicle dynamics: wheel force transducers, component test stands, road load data acquisition, NVH, misuse and complete car testing.

props.title: Vehicle Dynamic Test and Equipment
paragraphs: Handling, ride comfort, braking and stability decide how a vehicle performs and how a brand is judged. As vehicles become more electrified, software-driven and automated, judging their dynamic behaviour takes accurate, synchronised, highly sampled measurement data, for example for safety tests such as the elk test and for the fast control loops of driver assistance and automated driving systems.
imc offers measurement and evaluation solutions for every vehicle component, from prototype testing to quality assurance, and for complete vehicles on the road and on the test bench.
